description: The workhorse list row for a leaf category or subcategory. Shows an icon, name (tap to drill into transactions), an inline progress bar with spent/left/over, status chips, and a tappable budget-amount pill that becomes an inline editor. Tokenized re-skin of the existing CategoryBudgetRow.

category.description: id, name, color, icon, budget_amount, budget_id, spent, unverified_count

onSetBudget.type: (categoryId: string, budgetId: string | null | undefined, amount: number) => void

isSubcategory.description: Adds spacing.xxl left indent and reduces icon/type sizes

interactions.tapAmount: enter inline edit; focus TextInput; submit on blur/return; optimistic update then reload

regions.name: typography.smallBold colors.text (sub: typography.small colors.textMuted), numberOfLines 1
regions.noBudget: '{spent} spent · No budget set' or 'Tap amount to set budget' typography.caption colors.textDark

accessibility.rowLabel: {name}, {spent} spent of {budget}, {left|over}{, over budget}. Double tap to view transactions.
accessibility.pillLabel: Set budget for {name}, currently ${amount}. Double tap to edit.
accessibility.reviewChipLabel: {n} transactions to review in {name}. Double tap to open.
accessibility.note: Over budget = wash + Over chip + error progress + 'over' text; four signals, never color-only.

developerNotes: Drive progress color off the shared budgetStatus helper. Amount pill is flexShrink:0 (never truncates); name is numberOfLines:1 + ellipsis.
